description:
Configure safety protocols for the 'Depression Screening - Fall 2024' survey. 

1. Go to Survey Settings > 'Notification & data management'. Set the 'Send detailed admin notification to' field to send an email to 'dr.patel@clinical-safety.org' ONLY if the participant answers 'Yes' (code 'Y') to the 'safety_check' question. Use Expression Manager syntax: {if(safety_check == 'Y', 'dr.patel@clinical-safety.org', '')}

2. In the 'Screening Items' group, create a new question of type 'Text display'. Set the code to 'crisis_resource' and the question text to include '988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline'.

3. Set the 'Condition' (Relevance equation) for this new question so it ONLY appears if 'safety_check' equals 'Y'. (Equation: safety_check == "Y")

4. Save your changes.
